afterDefects: Overcast sky is slightly grey and dull, and the distant mountains are a bit flat. Otherwise there is strong contrast, real shadows, rich cobblestone and grass, and the player is easy to read.
Saturation is slightly heavy and the red tree canopies have a blobby look. There is a dark smudge on the cobblestones to the right of the player. The player is small and placed off-centre.
Sky and horizon are a little dull and grey-purple. Distant mountains are low-poly. Otherwise strong contrast, rich cobblestone and grass, readable player, warm red trees framing the gate.

The cliff faces have a faceted, low-poly look, the purple sky is somewhat muddy and the shield bubble ring looks slightly odd. Otherwise the depth, lighting, composition and player readability are strong.

The green rock wall on the right is faceted, low-poly and slightly muddy. The ellipse effect near the player is a little distracting. Distant enemies on the bridge are small. Overall the frame is strong, with warm dusk lighting, good depth and a readable player.

Cliff faces are faceted and low-poly with plain green shading. A translucent golden ring/shield effect next to the player is a little distracting, and a few small blue orbs float over the bridge (probably pickups). Otherwise vibrant, deep, and well composed, with a clear player on the bridge.

A flat green bar or plank floats across the bottom of the frame. The dark blue roof planes on the right look like stretched sheets, the player is a glowing orange blob that is hard to read, and the distant mountains are slightly hazy. Still, the frame has rich depth, a sunset mood and dense city detail.

Large dark-blue sheet planes stretch across the right midground like stray geometry. A thin green bar crosses the bottom of the frame. The player is semi-transparent behind a glowing shield, which hurts readability. The far horizon has some haze. Even so, the scene is rich and has strong depth and mood.

Some odd dark-blue stretched roof planes on the right-centre look like geometry artifacts. The player is a translucent glowing orange figure, so it reads a little poorly against the orange chimney block. A thin green bar crosses the bottom edge. Otherwise a dramatic sunset mood, rich roof materials, and strong depth across the town and mountains.

The tree canopies are blobby with an odd brick-like texture, and the pale-blue ghost clones crowd the player a little. Otherwise the colour, shadows and depth are strong, and the player stays readable at the centre.

The tree canopies have a coarse, blocky, brick-like texture, and the pink tree looks muddy. The light-blue clone figures draw attention away from the player in the foreground. Otherwise it has strong colour, shadows and depth, and the player is easy to read.

Translucent blue clone figures crowd the foreground around the player (probably an intended clone effect, but busy). The big tree canopies have a blobby, stretched brick-like texture, and the pink tree looks a bit muddy. Otherwise vivid colour, strong shadows, good depth, and the player stays readable.
